name: Taking A Life
overview: Scripture clearly upholds the sanctity of human life, emphasizing that taking a life is a grave offense because humans are made in the image of God. The repeated command 'Thou shalt not kill' (Exodus 20:13; Deuteronomy 5:17) establishes a divine prohibition against unlawful killing. Furthermore, the law prescribes serious consequences for those who intentionally take a life, including capital punishment (Exodus 21:12; Leviticus 24:17), while also providing cities of refuge for those who kill unintentionally (Numbers 35:11), demonstrating God's justice and mercy in preserving life.
